spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact IDL family (html_menu_bar/menu_list/menu_item/sub_menu_element.idl, flag MenuElements) member-by-member, and — because the dev-trial surface landed in stages — diagnoses the iteration (none / early trio / current with submenu+checkable) rather than a bare boolean.

interactive.rationale: Probe button re-runs every row live, including a real showPopover() on a constructed menulist to test the implicit-popover contract.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises interface + member detection with iteration diagnosis; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: HTMLUnknownElement tag-sniffing trap shown with the parser's real output; per-member rows separate early members (checked, command) from current ones (defaultChecked, interestForElement, checkable).

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5206029088063488, the Open UI explainer, spec PR, APG pattern, and the Chromium IDL files.

conformance.rationale: The suite's interface, member, and implicit-popover assertions mirror these rows as self-contained checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP, two configurations: bare (verdict NOT SUPPORTED, tags parse HTMLUnknownElement) and --enable-blink-features=MenuElements (verdict EARLY ITERATION: trio real, submenu/checkable absent — matching the build's actual dev-trial stage). Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: yes/no verdicts emerald/rose; table scrolls in .tbl-wrap; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with caption and scoped headers; textual verdicts; status role=status aria-live; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table owns horizontal scroll; 0px page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Re-probe on a current-surface build
openQuestions.detail: No available build here carries <submenu> + fieldset.checkable; when one does (Chrome 143+ with the current dev-trial), capture the CURRENT SURFACE verdict and confirm the iteration table matches.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detect staged html element rollout instanceof
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Detect per-interface and per-member, never by tag creation alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: instanceof + 'member' in element rows; iteration verdict derived from member presence.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible menu menubar keyboard roving tabindex popover dropdown
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Result matrices as real tables with text verdicts.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native table, caption, scoped headers, text yes/no.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the probe distinguishes all three support stages with real evidence on this engine — bare run says NOT SUPPORTED via the HTMLUnknownElement trap, flag run correctly diagnoses the early dev-trial iteration including a real menulist showPopover().
